messages.subject: [Traminer-users] Looking for chapter author on sequence analysis

messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Routledge is preparing a textbook entitled /Key Concepts in Research 
Methods/ targeting BA and MA students in social sciences. It is 
organized as an encyclopaedia, with 65 entries presented in alphabetical 
order. The editors are looking for a specialist to write a 2000 
word-long entry on sequence analysis. PhD or postdoc authors will be 
considered, possibly with a more experienced person as second author. If 
you are interested, please write to me and I will pass on to the 
editorial board.

Best,
Philippe


-- 

*Philippe Blanchard

* Politics And International Studies 
<http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/pais> & Warwick Q-Step Centre 
<http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/cross_fac/q-step>
University of Warwick
Social Sciences | E2.14 | Coventry CV4 7AL | UK
+44 24 765 23 714

Director, MA in Politics, International Studies: Big Data and 
Quantitative Methods 
<http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/pais/study/studymasters/bigdata>
Co-director, BA in Politics, International Studies and Quantitative 
Methods 
<http://www2.warwick.ac.uk/fac/soc/pais/study/studyundergrad/polintqm/>
Co-convenor, ECPR Standing Group on Political Methodology 
<http://ecpr-methods.org>
Chair, Advisory Board of the ECPR Methods School 
<http://new.ecpr.eu/MethodSchools/MethodSchools.aspx>
--
2017. ?Comprehensively Mapping Political Science Methods: An 
Instructors? Survey.? /International Journal of Social Research 
Methodology/ (with B. Rihoux and P. ?lamos-Concha) 
<http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/13645579.2015.1129128>
2016. ?Les vicissitudes de l?innovation m?thodologique. ?Validit?,

Abbott, sociologue de Chicago. H?ritages, d?passements, ruptures/ 
(Jouvenet and Demazi?re, Eds) <http://lettre.ehess.fr/index.php?9624>
2015. ?Le c?ur des affaires de la zone euro. Une analyse structurale et 
s?quentielle des ?lites ?conomiques transnationales.? /Cultures et 
Conflits/ 98 (2): 71-99 (with F.-X. Dudouet and A. Vion) 
<http://www.cairn.info/resume.php?ID_ARTICLE=CC_098_0071>
